function.name: SIMPLE_ANSWER
function.description: Just reply to user with answer and do no other activity.

smart_answer.description: The answer to provide to the user.

function.name: GET_CAPABILITY
function.description: Get the required data capabilities for the AI to make decisions. Possible types are CONTACTS, SHORTCUTS, APPS or NOTES.

capabilityType.description: Type of capability to retrieve (e.g., CONTACTS, SHORTCUTS, APPS, NOTES).

capabilityQuery.description: Specific query or subject to search within the capability type.

function.name: EXECUTION_REEVALUATE
function.description: This command should be used to re-evaluate the action list with results and continue processing.

function.name: EXECUTION_END
function.description: This is returned at the end of the task list for everyone to know when to stop processing.

function.name: WORKING_MEMORY_CLEAR
function.description: Clear AI working memory.

function.name: WORKING_MEMORY_SAVE
function.description: Save data to working memory for future AI processing.

data.description: The data to save into working memory.

function.name: CONTACTS_FIND
function.description: Find a contact.

contact_query.description: The query to search for contacts (e.g., name or part of the name).

function.name: CONTACTS_CREATE
function.description: Add a new contact.

contact_name.description: The full name of the contact.

contact_phone.description: The phone number of the contact.

contact_email.description: The email address of the contact (optional).

function.name: EVENTS_CREATE
function.description: Create a new event in calendar or user-defined app.

app_shortcut_id.description: The ID of the app or shortcut to use.

event_start_time.description: The start time of the event in ISO 8601 format.

event_end_time.description: The end time of the event in ISO 8601 format.

all_day.description: Whether the event is an all-day event.

extra_emails.description: Additional email addresses to invite to the event (comma-separated).

function.name: NAVIGATION_TO
function.description: Navigate to a location string address.

app_or_shortcut_id.description: The ID of the navigation app or shortcut to use.

location_name.description: The destination address or place name.

function.name: NAVIGATION_FIND_NEARBY_CATEGORY
function.description: Find nearby category.

category_name.description: The category to find nearby (e.g., restaurants, hotels).

function.name: MESSAGING_SEND_MESSAGE
function.description: Send a message to a contact on a user-defined app or shortcut.

app_or_shortcut_id.description: The ID of the messaging app or shortcut to use.

contact_name.description: The name of the contact to message.

contact_phone.description: The phone number of the contact.

function.name: MESSAGING_SEND_EMAIL
function.description: Send an email to a contact using the user's default app.

contact_name.description: The name of the contact to email.

contact_email.description: The email address of the contact.

email_body.description: The body content of the email.

function.name: MESSAGING_SEND_SMS
function.description: Send an SMS to a contact using the default SMS app or shortcut.

app_or_shortcut_id.description: The ID of the SMS app or shortcut to use.

contact_name.description: The name of the contact to message.

contact_phone.description: The phone number of the contact.

sms_body.description: The SMS message content to send.

note_queries.description: Array of queries to search within notes.

function.name: NOTES_CREATE
function.description: Create a new note.

function.description: Open web search.

search_query.description: The query to search on the web.

function.name: WEB_OPEN_URL
function.description: Open a URL.

function.name: VOICE_SAY_USER
function.description: Say something to the user.

voice_message.description: The message to speak to the user.

function.name: PHONE_CALL
function.description: Call a phone number.

app_or_shortcut_id.description: The ID of the phone app or shortcut to use.

contact_name.description: The name of the contact to call.

function.description: Call a phone number with a message.

app_or_shortcut_id.description: The ID of the phone app or shortcut to use.

contact_name.description: The name of the contact to call.

function.description: Launch a shortcut or app.

app_or_shortcut_id.description: The ID of the app or shortcut to launch.

function.description: Launch a shortcut or app with extra intent input parameters.

app_or_shortcut_id.description: The ID of the app or shortcut to launch.

key.description: The key of the extra parameter.

value.description: The value of the extra parameter.

extra_input_values.description: Array of key-value pairs for extra intent input parameters.

function.description: Delay for a given amount of time in milliseconds.
